title: fix(spec): a connector read serves only the declared nested keys, and a save of the served form keeps the rest

domain:server#2 · os-project-manager · session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1zG3Xn4JonaKvDLLr5gnjL)_

Refs #28284

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：读取 connector 时，`retryConfig` 里和 `actions` 每个元素里只返回各自 schema 声明过的键，其余整键不返回；形状不对的 `retryConfig` / `actions` 整体不返回；库里的行不变。原样保存时这些值从库里带回不丢；`actions` 元素按 `key` 对应，重排也不串位；作者删掉 `retryConfig` 或某个 action 时才删。`getPublished` 对作者文档脱敏，元数据层的标量记账键原样返回，多次发布留下的嵌套快照同样逐层脱敏。
- **为什么改**：QA 第三轮发现的安全加固(细节按披露裁决不公开)
- **风险与回滚**：spec / metadata-protocol / metadata 三个 patch。保存接受什么不变。连带变化：carry-forward 中没有 `id` 的数组元素现在按 `key` 识别(目前只有 connector 的 action 有这种形状)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/spec/src/integration/connector-credential-redaction.ts`(模块说明第 8 项与 `undeclaredNestedKeysOf`) → `packages/metadata-protocol/src/metadata-redaction.ts` 的 `identityOf` → `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts` 的 `redactServedBody`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/integration/connector-credential-redaction.test.ts`，预期 52 passed。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位做 contract review 后落地。

## What changes

- **Connector read, nested shapes.** Inside `retryConfig` and inside each `actions` element, every metadata read exit serves only the keys `RetryConfigSchema` and `ConnectorActionSchema` declare. The declared sets are read from the schemas' own shapes. Each withheld position is named in `redactedKeys` (`retryConfig.<key>`, `actions.<index>.<key>`). A `retryConfig` that is not an object, and an `actions` that is not an array or holds an element that is not an object, are withheld whole and named by the container (a cleared form and an empty list are served as written; an element is never removed on its own). The stored row is never changed.
- **Carry-forward follows an action by its `key`.** `identityOf` in the protocol's carry-forward returns `id` when present, and otherwise a non-empty string `key`. A reordered `actions` list keeps each element's withheld value on that element; twin keys carry neither, the existing ambiguity rule. A removed `retryConfig` or element is not minted back.
- **`MetadataManager.getPublished`** hands the type's redactor the authored document alone, and serves the metadata layer's own scalar bookkeeping (`packageId`, `state`, the publish keys) beside the answer unchanged. A publish snapshot nested under `publishedDefinition` (a package published more than once) is served through the same redaction at every depth; any other bookkeeping value that is not a scalar is not served. A body with nothing to withhold at any depth is served as before.

Nothing an author can write changes; no public export changes.

## Why

QA 第三轮发现的安全加固(细节按披露裁决不公开)

## Verification

Every reading below is on head `8daa64f1` (two commits on `main` at `3ac22c9d`) unless it names `1fed7aac`, the first commit.

<details><summary>New tests</summary>

- `packages/spec/src/integration/connector-credential-redaction.test.ts`: nested keys withheld under `retryConfig` and per `actions` element; cleared values; the declared nested sets equal the schemas' shapes; a malformed `retryConfig` or `actions` withheld whole (four shapes) with the cleared-form control; input never mutated. The file reads 52 passed.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/metadata-redaction.connector-undeclared-keys.test.ts` (7): the served form withholds the keys (control); a served-form save keeps every value; a reordered `actions` list follows each element by `key`; the author's own value wins; a removed `retryConfig` or element is not minted back; twin keys carry neither; a malformed container withheld whole is kept at rest by a save of the served form.
- `packages/metadata/src/published-body-bookkeeping-redaction.test.ts` (5): a never-published row and a published snapshot keep their scalar bookkeeping beside the redacted answer; a package published twice is redacted at every depth; a non-scalar bookkeeping value that is not a snapshot is not served; a clean body is served as stored.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/connector-meta-door-undeclared-keys-withheld.dogfood.test.ts` (9): the HTTP read doors (item, `/layers`, `/published`, both list spellings) for a member and an administrator, plus the published read of a package published twice; served-form saves keep the values at rest, including a reordered `actions` list; a removed `retryConfig` is cleared. CONTROL: a `credentialRef` instance saves, reaches ready and dispatches.

</details>

| `key` identity alone | `1fed7aac` | metadata-protocol 2 failed / 6 (served-form save, reorder) · dogfood 1 failed / 8 (reorder) |
| `getPublished` at every depth (`metadata-manager.ts` set back to its `1fed7aac` blob) | `8daa64f1` | metadata 2 failed / 5 (published twice; non-scalar bookkeeping) · dogfood 1 failed / 9 (published twice) |

Restore leg each time: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuild exit 0, and the same files green again (the first two legs also read the marker absent from every built file: spec 588, metadata-protocol 24, metadata 42).

</details>
